title: Transversospinal muscles/
summary: The transversospinales are a group of muscles of the human back.
Their combined action is rotation and extension of the vertebral column.
These muscles are small and have a poor mechanical advantage for contributing to motion.
-the three semispinalis muscles, spanning 4-6 vertebral segments -semispinalis thoracis -semispinalis cervicis -semispinalis capitis
